dimensions.name: Knowledge Delta
dimensions.justification: Provides concrete thresholds (IOUsage >30% of bill, MinCapacity >2 ACU with avg CPU <10%, snapshots >90 days, backtrack >24h) and a precise break‑even formula (storage_GB × 0.4 M I/O) that a generic model would not know. However it restates many well‑known Aurora pricing basics without adding new nuance, and it omits deeper RI term‑break‑even analysis, so full 20 is not earned.

dimensions.name: Mindset + Appropriate Procedures
dimensions.justification: Encodes an AWS‑specific decision tree, exact CLI commands, and a disciplined verification flow (snapshot, CONFIRM, one‑dimension‑per‑window). The only shortfall is a missing explicit ordering for RI evaluation relative to other levers, which leaves a tiny procedural ambiguity.

dimensions.name: Anti-Pattern Quality
dimensions.justification: Contains a thorough NEVER list with concrete reasons (e.g., never switch I/O tier without break‑even, never drop Serverless min‑capacity below SLA, never purchase RI for a cluster slated for migration). It lacks a few common pitfalls such as latency impact of I/O‑Optimized switch and the risk of under‑provisioning ACU for bursty workloads, so two points are deducted.

dimensions.name: Specification Compliance
dimensions.justification: Front‑matter is complete, activation triggers, invocation schema, and example are present, enabling reliable activation. The description of "when to invoke" could be tighter (it mixes high‑level scenarios with low‑level triggers), so one point is deducted.

dimensions.name: Progressive Disclosure
dimensions.justification: The skill layers information (summary, strict contract, decision tree, detailed steps, anti‑patterns, navigation). However the initial sections are dense and present many details before the concise top‑level contract, causing some cognitive overload; two points are deducted.

dimensions.name: Freedom Calibration
dimensions.justification: Destructively‑changing operations are tightly constrained: mandatory snapshot, CONFIRM gate, one‑dimension‑per‑maintenance‑window, batch size limit of three clusters, and explicit safety checks. Calibration matches fragility perfectly.

dimensions.name: Pattern Recognition
dimensions.justification: Follows a recognizable structure (What it does → Output contract → Decision tree → Stepwise process → Anti‑patterns → Navigation). It is coherent but does not map exactly onto a named standard pattern (e.g., Mindset‑Process‑Tool), so one point is deducted.

dimensions.name: Practical Usability
dimensions.justification: Provides working CLI snippets, decision branches, and savings calculations, enabling an agent to execute the skill. Minor gaps remain: rounding inconsistencies in examples, incomplete handling of mixed‑engine clusters, and limited error handling for missing Cost Explorer data beyond the NEED_MORE_INFO branch. Two points are deducted.
